CustomField.description: Pipeline Health: Health Category. Health display formula.
CustomField.formula: IF( ISPICKVAL(Opportunity__r.StageName, "Closed Won"), "🟢 Closed Won", IF( ISPICKVAL(Opportunity__r.StageName, "Closed Lost"), "🔴 Closed Lost", IF( Close_Likelihood_Score__c >= 0.70, "🟢 Healthy", IF( Close_Likelihood_Score__c >= 0.45, "🟡 Needs Attention", "🔴 Off Track" ) ) ))
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Read-only health indicator derived from milestone scores. Do not edit.
CustomField.label: Health Category
